methodology.scope: One formal whole-batch quality web review of all40 frozen REVIEW_ITEMS:38 proposed shared concepts and2 excluded holds; earlier offline planning checks were not formal reviews.
methodology.authority: docs/CONTENT_LOOP.md quality bar and applicable CRITIQUE_RUBRIC sections A/C/D/F; owner procedure governs shared-graph growth.
methodology.web_checks: Independently opened live Romanian second/primary sources for every item, reading the specific predicates and Romanian landscape, home, garden, correspondence or school exposure. Rechecked current Romsilva honey HTML directly with a browser user agent after a parser failure. The cited school biology PDF was freshly fetched (HTTP200,46813076bytes), parsed with existing pdftotext, and compared with cached extracted text for the precise seed/petal/pollen/fern passages.
methodology.lexical_checks: Read all40 freshly fetched exact-head dexonline DEX/MDA/DOOM3 records from the factual reviewer serial pass and independently compared the module forms and selected literal senses. Made no dexonline requests while that spaced pass was running. Common noun inflections are inputs, not automatically verified synonyms.
methodology.recognition: Judged ordinary Romanian home/garden/orchard/forest experience and school botany/correspondence; specific educational, encyclopedic and public horticultural sources supply exposure evidence. No human recognition measurement, pageview statistic or hidden-target approval is claimed. Frequency supports recognition only and never rejects a concrete noun.
methodology.topology: Recomputed all164 actual module edges over38 proposed nodes plus the live bundle. Every aggregate distinct incoming/outgoing neighborhood meets4–8neighbors,at least2old,at least2same-category,at most2batch; all32distinct old IDs/categories match. Five reciprocal pool hypotheses are already canonicalized, with no parallel pair duplication. The postal trio, Scoarță and Petală each retain exactly2batch neighbors.
methodology.input_identity: Independently folded all206proposed label/alias keys with the live normalization_map: no duplicate folded keys, other live owners or same-batch collisions;168aliases remain distinct from38new labels. Piersic excludes piersici/piersicii/piersicilor already owned by Piersică; no form ownership moves.
methodology.game_limits: Approval concerns ordinary shared Cald guesses and semantic neighborhoods only. No curated round, new hidden target, public session replay, ranking fairness, game gate or five-incoming target threshold approval is inferred. Honest is_a/part_of directions were inspected; existing gates and local playthrough remain required.
